name: The Vermintoll Abomination

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Block on the facing page (PDF 573). The book gives no Secret. Its Hag's Head options need the matching head alive.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.summary: Four times a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the abomination fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead, 4 times a day.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.summary: Three hag heads (centipede, pigeon, weasel): 50 or more damage in one turn kills a random head; at the end of each of its turns it regains 20 HP and one dead head returns; all three dead means it dies.
traits.text: It has three heads: a centipede hag's, a pigeon hag's and a weasel hag's. Whenever it takes 50 damage or more in a single turn, one of its heads (chosen at random) dies. It dies if all its heads are dead. At the end of each of its turns, if it has at least 1 Hit Point and any head is dead, it regains 20 Hit Points and one dead head returns to life.

traits.name: Regional Effects (Lair)
traits.summary: Within a mile of its lair: giant centipedes, giant weasels and pigeons are common thieving nuisances, and the lair building itself makes picking locks and finding secret doors harder (Disadvantage).
traits.text: Regional effects while the abomination lives and keeps its lair in the hidden house. Endless Vermin (within 1 mile): Giant Centipedes, Giant Weasels and pigeons (use the Raven stat block) are common; they steal Tiny objects and spoil food. Loyal Dwelling (the lair and any larger structure around it): ability checks to pick locks or find secret doors have Disadvantage. Both end the moment it dies or moves its lair.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Three attacks, Cauldron Slam or Brew Spray in any mix.

actions.name: Brew Spray
actions.summary: +7, range 90 ft, 4d8+2 Acid; the target has -2 AC until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: Charisma, DC 18: Dispel Magic and Hypnotic Pattern at will; Contagion, Dream and Dominate Person once each a day.
actions.text: It casts one of these, needing no Material components (Charisma, spell save DC 18). At will: Dispel Magic, Hypnotic Pattern. 1/day each: Contagion, Dream, Dominate Person.

actions.name: Crushing Leap
actions.summary: Legendary only, once a round. Leaps to a space within 30 ft holding Large or smaller creatures: DC 17 Dex save or 2d10+4 Bludgeoning and Prone; on a success half damage and a 5-ft shove.

actions.name: Contagious Miasma (Centipede Hag Head)

params.ends: a successful DC 18 Con save when it finishes a Long Rest

actions.summary: Legendary (centipede head). One creature it sees within 5 ft: DC 18 Con save or 3d8 Poison and Poisoned, unable to regain Hit Points until it saves at the end of a Long Rest; half damage on a success.

actions.name: Overwhelming Doubt (Pigeon Hag Head)
actions.summary: Legendary (pigeon head). One creature it sees within 30 ft: DC 18 Wis save or 3d6 Psychic and Incapacitated until the end of its next turn; half damage on a success.

actions.name: Waking Nightmare (Weasel Hag Head)
actions.summary: Legendary (weasel head). One creature it sees within 30 ft: DC 18 Cha save or 2d10 Psychic and Frightened; while Frightened it takes its allies for enemies (save again each turn; a minute at most); half damage on a success.

options.name: Corrosive Teleport
options.summary: Teleports up to 60 ft to a space it sees; everyone within 10 ft of where it arrives makes a DC 18 Dex save or takes 2d6 Acid (half on a success).

options.name: Crushing Leap
options.summary: Leaps onto Large or smaller creatures within 30 ft: DC 17 Dex save or 2d10+4 Bludgeoning and Prone. Once a round.

options.name: Hag's Head: Contagious Miasma
options.summary: Centipede head: DC 18 Con save or 3d8 Poison and Poisoned with no healing. Needs that head alive; once a round.

options.name: Hag's Head: Overwhelming Doubt
options.summary: Pigeon head: DC 18 Wis save or 3d6 Psychic and Incapacitated. Needs that head alive; once a round.

options.name: Hag's Head: Waking Nightmare
options.summary: Weasel head: DC 18 Cha save or 2d10 Psychic and Frightened, seeing allies as enemies. Needs that head alive; once a round.

summary: Three hags fused to a cauldron: acid slams and sprays, coven spells, a head for each hex it can throw, and a body that regrows a lost head and 20 Hit Points every turn.

phases.name: Scream Ye Vermin
phases.summary: The vermin go into a frenzy over every surface: biting for all who stand on them.
